title: KestrelCare Remainder Authorization after a Limited Warranty Decision
content:
## When it applies

When a Kestrel limited warranty decision on the covered vehicle has already decided a repair order and left part of it unpaid, the KestrelCare Vehicle Service Contracts authorization of the same repair order settles what the plan still owes on it. The authorization is a KestrelCare claim decision on that repair order: it records the decision and the amount payable to the repair facility under the plan.

The decision is booked on the plan's history as a claim decision entry carrying the repair order number; the booking leaves the coverage remaining unchanged.

## Booking the decision: `authorize_stack_remainder_2296c771`

This is an agent-side tool. The representative unlocks `authorize_stack_remainder_2296c771` and then calls it. One call books one claim decision entry on the service contract's history, carrying the repair order number, the failure date and odometer, the vehicle system, the facility type, the decision, the estimate the decision was made on, the deductible applied and the amount payable to the facility.

### Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `service_contract_id` | reference number of the KestrelCare service contract the repair order is decided under, as returned by the service contract lookup | identifier |
| `repair_order_number` | the repair facility's repair order number, copied exactly as printed on the limited warranty decision record or as the holder reads it from the repair order | verbatim, character for character |
| `failure_date` | the date the failure was reported to the repair facility | YYYY-MM-DD |
| `odometer_at_failure` | the odometer reading on the repair order | non-negative integer miles, no separators |
| `component_system` | the vehicle system the failed part belongs to | one enum value, listed below |
| `repair_facility_type` | the kind of facility doing the repair | one enum value, listed below |
| `claim_decision` | the decision | one enum value, listed below |
| `requested_amount` | the repair estimate the decision is made on | USD, 2 decimals, rounded to the nearest cent |
| `deductible_amount` | the plan deductible applied on this decision | USD, 2 decimals; 0.00 when none is applied |
| `approved_amount` | the amount payable to the facility under this decision | USD, 2 decimals, rounded to the nearest cent; 0.00 for a denial |

**`component_system` values:** `engine`, `transmission`, `drive_axle`, `transfer_case`, `cooling_system`, `fuel_system`, `electrical`, `air_conditioning`, `steering`, `brakes`, `suspension`, `hybrid_ev_drive_system` (hybrid or electric drive system), `high_tech_electronics`, `seals_and_gaskets` (a seal or gasket), and `not_applicable` only for a request that names no vehicle system at all.

**`repair_facility_type` values:** `kestrel_network` (Kestrel network facility), `franchise_dealer` (franchised new-car dealer), `independent_licensed` (independent licensed repair shop), and `not_applicable` only when no facility is involved.

**`claim_decision` values:** `approved` (approved for payment), `denied_waiting_period` (the failure falls before coverage started), `denied_contract_not_in_force` (the contract was not in force for the failure), `denied_not_covered_component` (the failed part is outside the covered components), `denied_preexisting_condition` (the condition existed before the sale or the vehicle is in commercial use), `denied_maintenance_records` (required maintenance proof is missing). `not_applicable` is never used for a decision.

### Return

On success the decision appears in the contract's service history and the tool returns a text receipt with `status` (the string "recorded"), `warranty_txn_id` (reference of the new claim decision entry), `repair_order_number`, `claim_decision` and `approved_amount` (USD with 2 decimals).
